data.one_liner: Creates Flutter Color instances from CSS color strings according to CSS Color Module Level 3.
data.what_it_does: Parses CSS color strings such as Hex, RGB(A), HSL(A), and X11 keywords into Flutter Color instances. Also provides an extension method to convert a Color back to a CSS color string and a function to check string correctness.
use_when: You need to parse standard CSS color strings in Flutter.
You are integrating web-based themes or styles that use CSS colors.
You want to convert Flutter Color instances back to CSS color strings.
avoid_when: You are working with color spaces outside of CSS Color Module Level 3.
strengths: Supports multiple formats including Hex, RGB(A), HSL(A), and X11 keywords.
Includes backwards conversion to CSS color strings via extension method.
Provides validation for CSS color strings.
weaknesses: Limited to CSS Color Module Level 3.
